tenderSchedule.title: OFFICE STATIONARIES-2026
tenderSchedule.description: Supply of Various types of office stationeries for Varahi Hydro Electric Project.
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer MSP Office SVP VARAHI

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
GENERAL CONDITIONS AS PER BRIEF BID

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular supplier and shall have proven experience in the field of supplying stationeries to any public /private /reputed organizations in India. In proof of the above, purchase order and invoice copy/supply completion certificate- in a single purchase order copy (If KPCL PO furnished, MRN will be verified) of total value not less than Rs.1.61 Lakh in the last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25, 2025-26) & upto the date of tender shall be furnished. Purchase orders of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- purchase order and invoice copy/supply completion certificate- in a single purchase order copy

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders in the last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26) should have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 3.22 Lakhs. In proof, Annual report/turn over certificates duly certified by chartered accountant shall be furnished. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The agency should furnish details and complete specifications / make intended to supply for the above subject part-1 of the bid
The Bidders shall upload a copy of GST Registration certificate.
The Bidders shall upload a copy of IT-PAN.
The Bidders shall upload DECLARATION-I FORMAT ENCLOSED duly with seal and sign.
The Bidders shall upload DECLARATION-II FORMAT ENCLOSED duly with seal and sign.
The Bidders shall upload FORM OF BID FORMAT ENCLOSED duly with seal and sign.
The Bidders shall upload BIDDER DETAILS ENCLOSED duly with seal and sign.
